caseName: Voting for America, Inc. v. Andrade
caseNameFull: Voting for America, Inc. v. Andrade, Secretary of State of Texas

opinions.text:
Application to vacate the stay entered by the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit on September 6, 2012, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Sotomayor would grant the application in part.
